name: SCW Lonestar Heavyweight Title
epitaph: The federation's top singles championship, its vacant tournament won by Pat Gordon, Jr. on 8 December 2019 at the Showdown I iPPV; "Celtic Crippler" Caleb Foley took it from him on the following Rampage, 28 January 2020, in a Triangle Match also involving Alfie Button. Foley's win is the last change the federation's own title history recorded.
source: The federation's own Lonestar Heavyweight Title History page, served as /promotions/scw-southwestern-2019/archive/lonestartitlehistory.html

name: SCW Lonestar Tag Team Titles
epitaph: The federation's tag championship, opened on Las Preguntas at the federation's own first show, 18 June 2019, in a Fatal 4-Way over the Rich Family, the Health Fanatics and the Prague Drinking Team. Davey-Boy O'Brien and Keegan took it from them on 8 December 2019 at Showdown I in a Texas Tornado match, the last change the federation's own title history recorded.
source: The federation's own Lonestar Tag Team Title History page, served as /promotions/scw-southwestern-2019/archive/lonestartagtitlehistory.html
